name: Dynamic Serena 2-Person Low EMF Far Infrared Sauna
description: Dynamic Serena 2-Person Low EMF (Between 5-10 mg) Far Infrared Sauna (Canadian Hemlock) Experience the ultimate blend of relaxation and wellness with our Dynamic Saunas, crafted from premium, eco-friendly Canadian Hemlock wood. Designed with both durability and elegance in mind, each sauna is equipped with advanced Low EMF FAR infrared heating panels that deliver gentle, energy-efficient warmth to help relieve stress, improve circulation, and rejuvenate your body from the inside out. Perfect for those seeking a natural way to unwind, our saunas create a spa-like escape right in the comfort of your home. Easy to install and thoughtfully designed for modern living, Dynamic Saunas can be placed in virtually any indoor space whether it’s your basement, master bath, walk-in closet, or home fitness room. With their compact yet stylish construction, they fit seamlessly into your lifestyle while offering the long-term health and relaxation benefits of infrared therapy. Bring home a Dynamic Sauna today and enjoy daily wellness, energy renewal, and relaxation without ever leaving your house. Features: Low EMF - EMF between 5-10 mg 2 to 3 inches from the heating panels 2-person capacity 7 Dynamic Low EMF Far Infrared Carbon heating panels Natural Reforested Canadian Hemlock wood construction Clear Tempered glass door Interior Chromotherapy Color Lighting System + Red Light Therapy Feature Interior LED Control Panels 118F-132F is the deal temperature range, sauna can heat up to 140F Bluetooth and MP3 auxiliary connection with built in speakers Clasp together assembly Roof vent Indoor use only Ships in 2 boxes Specifications: Sauna weight: 310 lbs. Shipping weight: 370 lbs. Electrical service: 120V/15amp Non GFCI plug & play (Recommended Dedicated Outlet) Exterior dimensions (LWH): 40″ x 46″ x 75″ Interior dimensions (LWH): 36″ x 42″ x 68″ Document: View Owner's Manual
